Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing the sheriff to waive fees associated with the service of a writ of habeas corpus under certain circumstances.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fees associated with service of writs of habeascorpus; and adding a new section to chapter 7.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 7.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Notwithstanding RCW 36.18.040, the sheriff may waive feesassociated with service of a writ of habeas corpus that was issued forthe return of a child when the person who was granted the writ is, byreason of poverty, unable to pay the cost of service.
